answer.en: We provide six core service lines: Software Development, Infrastructure & Networking, Cloud & DevOps, Creative Design, Digital Printing & Advertising, and IT Consulting & Training.
answer.id: Kami menyediakan enam lini layanan utama: Pengembangan Software, Infrastruktur & Jaringan, Cloud & DevOps, Desain Kreatif, Percetakan Digital & Periklanan, serta Konsultasi & Pelatihan IT.

question.en: What products and services do you offer?
question.id: Produk dan layanan apa saja yang Anda tawarkan?

answer.en: If you need a business system or app, choose Software Development. If your issue is servers, network, CCTV, or hardware, choose Infrastructure & Networking. If you need cloud migration, CI/CD, or Kubernetes, choose Cloud & DevOps. For brand visuals and interfaces, choose Creative Design. For physical promotional media, choose Digital Printing & Advertising. For strategy and capability building, choose IT Consulting & Training.
answer.id: Jika Anda membutuhkan sistem bisnis atau aplikasi, pilih Pengembangan Software. Jika kendalanya server, jaringan, CCTV, atau hardware, pilih Infrastruktur & Jaringan. Jika membutuhkan migrasi cloud, CI/CD, atau Kubernetes, pilih Cloud & DevOps. Untuk visual brand dan antarmuka, pilih Desain Kreatif. Untuk media promosi fisik, pilih Percetakan Digital & Periklanan. Untuk strategi dan peningkatan kapabilitas tim, pilih Konsultasi & Pelatihan IT.

question.en: How do we choose the right service for our business needs?
question.id: Bagaimana memilih layanan yang paling sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis kami?

answer.en: Yes. Many clients combine services in one project, for example software development with cloud setup, infrastructure deployment, UI/UX design, and promotional materials for launch.
answer.id: Ya. Banyak klien menggabungkan beberapa layanan dalam satu proyek, misalnya pengembangan software dengan setup cloud, implementasi infrastruktur, desain UI/UX, serta materi promosi saat peluncuran.

question.en: Can we combine multiple services in one engagement?
question.id: Apakah beberapa layanan bisa digabung dalam satu kerja sama?

answer.en: Deliverables are adjusted by scope, such as source code and documentation (software), server/network topology and implementation report (infrastructure), deployment pipeline and observability setup (cloud/devops), design files and brand assets (creative), and ready-to-install print/display outputs (printing).
answer.id: Deliverable disesuaikan dengan lingkup, seperti source code dan dokumentasi (software), topologi server/jaringan dan laporan implementasi (infrastruktur), pipeline deployment dan setup observability (cloud/devops), file desain dan aset brand (kreatif), serta hasil cetak/display siap pasang (percetakan).

question.id: Output atau deliverable apa yang akan kami terima?

answer.en: Absolutely. We support end-to-end implementation and post-launch support, including system maintenance, monitoring, technical support, and periodic optimization based on your service scope.
answer.id: Tentu. Kami mendukung implementasi end-to-end dan dukungan pasca go-live, termasuk maintenance sistem, monitoring, dukungan teknis, serta optimasi berkala sesuai lingkup layanan Anda.

question.en: Do you provide implementation and post-go-live support?
question.id: Apakah Anda menyediakan implementasi dan dukungan setelah go-live?

answer.en: Pricing can be project-based (fixed scope), milestone-based, or recurring (maintenance/retainer), depending on complexity, timeline, required resources, and expected deliverables.
answer.id: Skema biaya dapat berupa project-based (lingkup tetap), milestone-based, atau recurring (maintenance/retainer), tergantung kompleksitas, timeline, kebutuhan resource, dan deliverable yang disepakati.

answer.en: Timeline depends on scope. Digital printing requests may finish in days, while software, infrastructure, and cloud projects generally start with discovery and planning, then continue in phased milestones. We provide a clear proposal with scope, cost, and schedule at the beginning.
answer.id: Timeline bergantung pada lingkup kerja. Kebutuhan percetakan digital bisa selesai dalam hitungan hari, sedangkan proyek software, infrastruktur, dan cloud umumnya dimulai dari discovery dan perencanaan lalu berjalan per milestone. Di awal, kami menyiapkan proposal yang jelas terkait scope, biaya, dan jadwal.

question.en: How long does a typical project take and what is the process?
question.id: Berapa lama proyek biasanya berjalan dan bagaimana prosesnya?

answer.en: Yes. We can integrate with existing systems through API and data migration planning. For security, we apply access control, backup strategy, environment separation, and monitoring based on project requirements.
answer.id: Ya. Kami dapat terintegrasi dengan sistem existing melalui API dan perencanaan migrasi data. Untuk keamanan, kami menerapkan kontrol akses, strategi backup, pemisahan environment, dan monitoring sesuai kebutuhan proyek.

question.en: Can you integrate with our existing system and handle security?
question.id: Apakah bisa terintegrasi dengan sistem existing kami sekaligus menjaga keamanannya?

answer.en: We support both remote and on-site delivery depending on your location and service type. Our team can coordinate hybrid execution for implementation, training, and support.
answer.id: Kami mendukung delivery remote maupun on-site sesuai lokasi dan tipe layanan. Tim kami dapat mengatur eksekusi hybrid untuk implementasi, pelatihan, dan dukungan.

question.en: Do you serve projects outside your city or region?
question.id: Apakah melayani proyek di luar kota atau luar wilayah?

answer.en: To speed up consultation, prepare your business goals, current pain points, required timeline, target budget range, and available technical assets (domain, hosting/server, existing system, or brand guideline if any).
answer.id: Agar konsultasi lebih cepat, siapkan tujuan bisnis, kendala utama saat ini, target timeline, kisaran budget, serta aset teknis yang sudah tersedia (domain, hosting/server, sistem existing, atau brand guideline jika ada).
